Why Bay Breeze

Teaching-first real estate, not high-pressure sales

Founded by former teachers, we break down complex contracts and market trends so you can buy your first home with total confidence.

01

Jargon-Free Guidance

We translate complicated purchase contracts and market trends into plain English so you always know what you're signing.

02

Hyperlocal Expertise

Deep neighborhood knowledge across Alameda, Oakland, and the East Bay waterfront communities where we live and work.

03

Zero Pressure

No rushed decisions or aggressive sales tactics. Take your time browsing open houses and learning the ropes.

04

Community Workshops

Join our free monthly first-time buyer classes at the Alameda library and casual weekend open house crawl tours.

How It Works

A simple path from renter to homeowner

1

Learn & Plan

We sit down in our Alameda office to discuss your budget, timeline, and goals without any rush.

2

Browse & Tour

Join our weekend open house crawls to explore East Bay neighborhoods at a relaxed, comfortable pace.

3

Strategize

We review comparable sales together and craft a smart offer strategy that protects your interests.

4

Close

We guide you step-by-step through inspections, paperwork, and closing day with zero guesswork.
